external_smoke.reason: No approved third-party MCP OAuth credential or production Secret Store writer is configured; the Phase waiver permits this after mock protocol gates pass.

checks.evidence: Closed API and DB transport checks reject tenant stdio and every transport except streamable_http.
Security tests reject non-TLS tenant URLs, URL userinfo, malformed exact origins and disallowed Origin values.

Create and update reject private IP literals and hostnames whose DNS set contains a disallowed address before persistence. Runtime independently repeats the policy; transport-observation tests prove MCP and OAuth request URLs use the validated IP literal while retaining the original Host and TLS SNI, and live discovery returned stable MCP_SSRF_BLOCKED.
MCP and OAuth clients disable redirect following and reject 3xx responses.
Mock OAuth covers S256, one-time identity-bound state, metadata and issuer origin, exact resource and audience, scopes, expiry and replay denial.
MCP and OAuth clients abort chunked bodies while reading once the configured decoded-byte limit is crossed.
Protocol version, content type, JSON-RPC request ID and MCP session ID are pinned; confusion and mismatch tests fail closed.
Migration 074 has no token or client-secret columns; new MCP and Connector APIs persist opaque secret_ref only and never serialize it.
Redacted validation routes omit echoed input and context; upstream bodies, credentials, URLs, resolved IPs and stack details are absent from stable failures and Connector error storage or logging.
Composite database references and repository predicates reject cross-tenant resources; delegated connections resolve only the authenticated owner and never fall back.

Remote readOnlyHint/risk metadata is never trusted. Anonymous, public and embed eligibility requires a Tenant Admin service-account grant bound to the exact current tool schema hash and channel; schema drift and delegated public use are denied.
Confluence Agent runtime resolves the shared principal repository, scopes and channels before invocation; legacy visibility cannot re-add a Connector to an Agent allowlist.

PostgreSQL rejects snapshot updates or deletes; schema hashes remain pure and exact. Compatibility recurses through nested object/array schemas; added properties, unknown validation changes and old-valid/new-invalid payloads are breaking, and any refresh invalidates exact-hash public approval.
AS-02 allowlist plus repository authorization requires the exact MCP or Connector provider, resource, version or hash and principal before ToolInvoker dispatch.
Whole-call timeout includes connection-capacity queueing; connection-global semaphore, failure recording, open-circuit denial and recovery behavior pass runtime and PostgreSQL tests.
AGENT_STUDIO_MCP_ENABLED=false removes external Agent capabilities while preserving native built-in Assistant behavior and stored registry evidence.
Server, connection, channel, discovery and Connector principal mutations return request_id and audit_ref; live CRUD verified the public contract.
